cards.front: Su pelo de ella ha crecido mucho desde que se lo tintó.
cards.back: Her hair's grown quite a bit since she dyed it.

cards.front: Su pelo de él ha crecido mucho desde que se lo afeitó.
cards.back: His hair's grown a lot since he shaved it.

cards.front: Mi pelo ha crecido un montón desde que me lo corté.
cards.back: My hair's grown loads since I cut it.

cards.front: Voy a dejar que me crezca el pelo.
cards.back: I'm going to let my hair grow.

cards.front: Voy a dejar que me crezca el pelo hasta que esté muy largo.
cards.back: I'm going to let my hair grow really long.

cards.front: Me aburre tener el pelo corto. Voy a dejar que me crezca.
cards.back: I'm bored of short hair. I'm going to let it grow.

cards.front: Jim empezó a dejarse bigote cuando tenía veinte años.
cards.back: Jim started growing a moustache when he was twenty.

cards.front: Jack empezó a dejarse barba cuando tenía dieciocho años.
cards.back: Jack started growing a beard when he was eighteen.

cards.front: John empezó a dejarse patillas antes de que Jim empezara a dejarse bigote, pero después de que Jack empezara a dejarse barba.
cards.back: John started growing sideburns before Jim started growing a moustache but after Jack started growing a beard.

cards.front: ¡¿Qué pasó con todo tu bonito pelo?! No pasa nada, volverá a crecer.
cards.back: What happened to all your beautiful hair?! Never mind; it'll grow back.

cards.front: ¡El peluquero me cortó todo el pelo! No pasa nada, volverá a crecer pronto.
cards.back: The hairdresser cut all my hair off! Never mind; it'll grow back soon.

cards.front: El barbero le cortó el pelo a él demasiado corto. No pasa nada, al menos volverá a crecer hasta su medida habitual algún día.
cards.back: The barber cut his hair too short. Never mind; at least it'll grow back to its usual length some day.

cards.front: Su nuevo corte de pelo de ella en realidad no le sienta bien, pero crecerá.
cards.back: Her new haircut doesn't really suit her but it will grow out.

cards.front: El peinado no le sienta bien a ella, pero pronto crecerá.
cards.back: The hairstyle doesn't suit her but it'll grow out soon.

cards.front: El flequillo en realidad no le sienta nada bien a ella, pero le crecerá con el tiempo.
cards.back: A fringe doesn't really suit her but it'll grow out eventually.

cards.front: Mi padrino creció en Sídney.
cards.back: My godfather grew up in Sydney.

cards.front: Mi madrina creció en Melbourne.
cards.back: My godmother grew up in Melbourne.

cards.front: Mis dos padres crecieron en Canberra.
cards.back: My parents both grew up in Canberra.

cards.front: Nací en Dublín, pero crecí en Estados Unidos.
cards.back: I was born in Dublin but grew up in the United States.

cards.front: Él nació en Cork, pero creció en Estados Unidos.
cards.back: He was born in Cork but grew up in the States.

cards.front: Ella nació en Belfast, pero creció en EE.UU.
cards.back: She was born in Belfast but grew up in the US.

cards.front: Él creció en Glasgow, pero no tiene un acento marcado.
cards.back: He grew up in Glasgow, but he doesn't have a strong accent.

cards.front: Crecieron en Londres, pero no tienen acentos londinenses marcados.
cards.back: They grew up in London but they don't have strong London accents.

cards.front: Ella creció en Cardiff, pero no tiene un acento galés marcado.
cards.back: She grew up in Cardiff but she doesn't have a strong Welsh accent.

cards.front: Anna no creció en Toronto. Creció en Vancouver.
cards.back: Anna didn't grow up in Toronto. She grew up in Vancouver.

cards.front: Peter no creció en Vancouver. Creció en Montreal.
cards.back: Peter didn't grow up in Vancouver. He grew up in Montreal.

cards.front: John y Mary no crecieron en Quebec. Crecieron en Ottawa.
cards.back: John and Mary didn't grow up in Quebec. They grew up in Ottawa.

cards.front: ¿Dónde creciste? Crecí en el norte de Inglaterra.
cards.back: Where did you grow up? I grew up in Northern England.

cards.front: ¿Dónde crecieron tus padres? Crecieron en el sureste.
cards.back: Where did your parents grow up? They grew up in the South East.

cards.front: ¿Dónde creció tu marido? Creció en Oriente Próximo.
cards.back: Where did your husband grow up? He grew up in the Middle East.

cards.front: Cuando era pequeño siempre íbamos de vacaciones a Irlanda.
cards.back: When I was growing up, we always went on holiday to Ireland.

cards.front: Cuando mi amiga era pequeña siempre iba de vacaciones a Francia.
cards.back: When my friend was growing up, she always went on holiday to France.

cards.front: Cuando mi madre era pequeña siempre iba de vacaciones a Gales.
cards.back: When my mum was growing up, she always went on holiday to Wales.

cards.front: Cuando éramos pequeños siempre jugábamos al fútbol en el parque.
cards.back: When we were growing up, we always used to play football in the park.

cards.front: Cuando eran pequeños siempre jugaban en su jardín.
cards.back: When they were growing up, they always used to play in their garden.

cards.front: Cuando mis padres eran pequeños siempre jugaban en la calle.
cards.back: When my parents were growing up, they always used to play in the street.

cards.front: Nunca jugábamos en la calle cuando éramos pequeños.
cards.back: We never used to play in the street when we were growing up.

cards.front: Mi hermano nunca jugaba al fútbol en el parque cuando era pequeño.
cards.back: My brother never used to play football in the park when he was growing up.

cards.front: Mi padre nunca iba a nadar cuando era pequeño.
cards.back: My dad never used to go swimming when he was growing up.

cards.front: Siempre íbamos a nadar cada semana cuando éramos pequeños.
cards.back: We would always go swimming every week when we were growing up.

cards.front: Siempre comíamos helado los viernes cuando éramos pequeños.
cards.back: We would always have ice cream on Fridays when we were growing up.

cards.front: Siempre veíamos dibujos animados los sábados por la mañana cuando éramos pequeños.
cards.back: We would always watch cartoons on Saturday mornings when we were growing up.

cards.front: Cuando él era pequeño nunca hacía sus deberes.
cards.back: When he was growing up he would never do his homework.

cards.front: Cuando ellos eran pequeños nunca ayudaban con las tareas de la casa.
cards.back: When they were growing up they would never help with the housework.

cards.front: Cuando mi hermana era pequeña nunca iba a nadar.
cards.back: When my sister was growing up she would never go swimming.

cards.front: Nos iremos a vivir a la costa cuando envejezcamos.
cards.back: We'll move to the coast when we grow old.

cards.front: Se irán a vivir a una casa más pequeña cuando envejezcan.
cards.back: They'll move into a smaller house when they grow old.

cards.front: Ella se irá a vivir con su hijo cuando envejezca.
cards.back: She'll move in with her son when she grows old.

cards.back: We grew tired of the situation.

cards.front: Ellos se cansaron de su compañía de él.
cards.back: They grew tired of his company.

cards.front: Ella se cansó de sus mentiras de él.
cards.back: She grew tired of his lies.

cards.back: The situation's grown worse since yesterday.

cards.front: El problema ha empeorado mucho desde el comienzo.
cards.back: The problem's grown a lot worse since the start.

cards.front: El asunto ha empeorado mucho desde entonces.

cards.back: It had grown cold by evening.

cards.front: Había refrescado mucho para cuando cayó la noche.
cards.back: It had grown very cold by dusk.

cards.front: Había refrescado un poco para cuando cayó la noche.
cards.back: It had grown chilly by nightfall.

cards.back: It was growing dark by the time we arrived.

cards.back: It was growing dark by the time we got there.

cards.front: Estaba oscureciendo para cuando llegamos todos a casa.
cards.back: It was growing dark by the time we all got home.

cards.front: Antes ella me parecía molesta, pero ha llegado a caerme bien.
cards.back: I used to find her annoying but I've grown to like her.

cards.front: Antes ellos me parecían irritantes, pero han llegado a caerme bien.
cards.back: I used to find them irritating, but I've grown to like them.

cards.front: Sé que antes él me parecía tedioso, pero ha llegado a caerme bien.
cards.back: I know I used to find him tedious, but I've grown to like him.

cards.front: Al principio no me gustaba mi nuevo trabajo, pero ha llegado a encantarme.
cards.back: I didn't like my new job at first, but I've grown to love it.

cards.front: No me gustaba mucho, pero ha llegado a encantarme.
cards.back: I didn't like it very much at first, but I've grown to love it.

cards.front: Sé que ni siquiera me caía bien cuando nos conocimos, pero ahora ha llegado a encantarme.
cards.back: I know I didn't even like him when we met, but now I've grown to love him.

cards.back: I liked it at first, but now I've grown to hate it.

cards.front: No me importaba al principio, pero he llegado a odiarlo.
cards.back: I didn't mind it at the beginning, but I've grown to hate it.

cards.front: Sé que me daba igual al principio, pero de verdad que he llegado a odiarlo.
cards.back: I know I was indifferent to it to start with, but I've really grown to hate it.

cards.front: No tuvo mucho éxito al principio, pero han llegado a aceptarlo.
cards.back: It was unpopular at the beginning, but they've grown to accept it.

cards.front: Aunque fue difícil al principio, han llegado a apreciarlo.

cards.front: Sé que fue desagradable al principio, pero la gente ha llegado a aceptarlo.
cards.back: I know it was unpleasant at first, but people have grown to accept it.

cards.front: Al principio no me entusiasmaba, pero me ha conquistado.
cards.back: I wasn't crazy about it at first, but it's grown on me.

cards.front: No les entusiasmaba al principio, pero les ha conquistado.
cards.back: They weren't thrilled to begin with, but it's grown on them.

cards.front: Al principio queríamos odiarlo, pero nos ha conquistado.
